movelist.name: Zen Headbutt
movelist.effect: Zen Headbutt Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Knock Off
movelist.effect: Choose one of the target’s Held Items or Accessory Slot Items. It is knocked to the ground.

movelist.name: Uproar
movelist.effect: All Pokémon and Trainers within 5 meters of the user are cured of sleep.

movelist.name: Nature Power
movelist.effect: Nature Power uses a Move defined by the Environ keyword.

movelist.name: Bubble Beam
movelist.effect: Bubble Beam lowers the target’s Speed on 18+.

movelist.name: Water Sport
movelist.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Fire Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Fire Type Move, the coat is removed.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.effect: The user gains a Tick of Hit Points. Rain Dish may only be used while the user is under 50% Hit Points or in Rainy Weather.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: While in Rainy Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Confidence
abilities.effect: Choose a Combat Stat. All allies within 5 meters of the user gain +1 CS in the Chosen Stat.
